rationale: The upgraded dependency version was applied, but Maven could not even build the selected module because a Vert.x dependency no longer had a managed version under the new BOM. The same POM-processing error appeared during the agent's build attempt and the final verifier install step, before source compilation or tests could run. This is best characterized as an unresolved dependency/build configuration failure rather than a semantic runtime failure.
